meta.title: Complete aneurysm centerline glyph network
meta.description: A deduplicated, acyclic parent-vessel centerline tree plus a connected neck-to-dome sac extension.
meta.interpretation: Parent-vessel values are cross-section-associated wall summaries; sac-extension values come from the nearest area-weighted sac-wall patch.
meta.limitation: The sac extension is a constructed guide path, not a VMTK medial axis or a direct measurement of sac-interior flow.
meta.unit: coordinates/radius/arclen in mm; glyph values globally positive-only rank-normalized to [0,1]
